description: Freedom of speech is not a partisan issue. It is the foundation of every other right we have. Without it, we cannot worship freely, govern ourselves, hold our elected officials accountable, or pass our values to the next generation. This session, Tennessee took meaningful action to defend it. HB 1476 protects free speech on college campuses across Tennessee.
